posts.author: Fedriz_Marini
posts.body:
Greetings, I was wondering if there was someone around here who could help me figure out which Tileset could fit my Game's sprites style.
I originally looked for the KR pack, but I am not very sure. I even tried to scale down (With "Nearest" option) the default 48x48 tileset to 24x24, but the results are a bit meh, or rather, not sure of how it looks.
Gladly waiting for feedback, and Thanks in advance!

posts.author: Fedriz_Marini
posts.body: Some of these are pretty, altho, my project take place in mix between fantasy and Sci-Fi (Urban in the middle), and I've noticed many of the 16x16 tilesets are more toward the classic fantasy, and unfortunately the tilesets that may have it have a very contrasting style, even 24x24 ones.

posts.author: Fedriz_Marini
posts.body: In the end I went with "Time Fantasy" since it has quite the range!
